routes.label: Reverse the rows and read the diagonals

question:
A \(4 \times 4\) block of calendar dates is shown. The order of the numbers in the second row is to be reversed. Then the order of the numbers in the fourth row is to be reversed. Finally, the numbers on each diagonal are to be added. What will be the positive difference between the two diagonal sums?

[Figure 1](figures/2008_AMC_10B_Q02_question_fig1.svg)
solution:
Reversing a row means reading its entries from right to left. Thus the second row becomes \(11,10,9,8\), and the fourth row becomes \(25,24,23,22\). The first and third rows stay as shown.

The diagonal running from the upper left to the lower right now has sum
\[
1+10+17+22=50.
\]
The diagonal running from the upper right to the lower left has sum
\[
4+9+16+25=54.
\]
Subtract the smaller sum from the larger to get the positive difference:
\[
54-50=\boxed{4}.
\]
The answer is \(\text{B}\).
